basics.name: Ahmed Samir
basics.label: AI Engineer
basics.summary: Undergraduate AI Researcher specializing in Computer Vision, 3D Spatial Reasoning, and Quantum Machine Learning. Kaggle Competitions Expert (peak global ranking of 768th, currently ranked 2nd nationally in Egypt) with a proven track record of multiple international hackathon victories and peer-reviewed research.

highlights: Engineered High Frequency Trading Algorithms using Reinforcement Learning.
Designed the state-action space and reward functions for financial market environments.

work.company: The Scientific Research School of Egypt (SRSEG) (Remote)
highlights: Engineered and trained 3+ YOLO variants with novel backbones (Swin Transformer, CBAM) for Dentist X-Ray Object Detection, achieving a new state-of-the-art mAP of 95.5%.
Actively participate in weekly research meetings and webinars, presenting findings and shaping new research directions.
Recruited into an internship following a 1st place win in the HERE Technologies Hackathon.
Worked on geospatial data with different database engines.
Worked with AWS services, Docker, and Linux.
Completed an intensive program in ML, DL, Agentic AI, and RAG on Huawei AI platforms.
Achieved a notebook bronze medal in the CIMBTR Kaggle competition (Top 10%) as part of the graduation project.
Developed an educational tool using RAG and Agentic AI to assist math teachers in identifying student misconceptions.
Awarded Full Scholarship & a copy of the e-book "Where Research Begins".
Researched double donor semiconductor Tellurium and wrote a 19-page paper.
Graded A, awarded 2 transferable credit hours, and evaluated as top 5% by Prof. Adhikari (Colgate University).
